content.text:
Siemens AG (the harmonized name cluster "SIEMENS" / "Siemens Aktiengesellschaft") filed about 32,500 applications from 2016 through 2025 across 49 offices, per PATSTAT 2026 Spring. The table below shows the eight largest offices by filing year, with everything else grouped as Other.

| Year | EP | WO | US | CN | DE | KR | CA | BR | Other | Total |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 2016 | 1,150 | 1,066 | 817 | 538 | 907 | 102 | 54 | 79 | 485 | 5,198 |
| 2017 | 1,190 | 1,217 | 671 | 532 | 797 | 79 | 75 | 61 | 370 | 4,992 |
| 2018 | 1,398 | 1,309 | 686 | 482 | 574 | 92 | 66 | 58 | 306 | 4,971 |
| 2019 | 1,210 | 1,216 | 635 | 429 | 275 | 48 | 37 | 28 | 178 | 4,056 |
| 2020 | 979 | 824 | 455 | 353 | 260 | 17 | 7 | 7 | 68 | 2,970 |
| 2021 | 1,003 | 740 | 490 | 475 | 131 | 28 | 10 | 13 | 46 | 2,936 |
| 2022 | 990 | 676 | 440 | 572 | 128 | 20 | 9 | 10 | 20 | 2,865 |
| 2023 | 940 | 681 | 254 | 516 | 174 | 10 | 1 | 0 | 17 | 2,593 |
| 2024 | 519 | 534 | 116 | 262 | 83 | 4 | 1 | 0 | 16 | 1,535 |
| 2025 | 12 | 245 | 46 | 75 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 3 | 381 |

Totals for the period by office:

| Office | Applications | Granted |
|---|---|---|
| EP | 9,391 | 2,388 |
| WO | 8,508 | n/a (PCT never grants) |
| US | 4,610 | 2,735 |
| CN | 4,234 | 1,355 |
| DE | 3,329 | 361 |
| KR | 400 | 286 |
| CA | 260 | 193 |
| BR | 256 | 152 |
| JP | 254 | 192 |

Points to keep in mind when reading this:

- **The 2024 and 2025 tail is a publication artifact, not a decline.** Applications surface in PATSTAT roughly 18 months after filing, so those years are incomplete.
- **The real drop starts around 2019 and 2020.** That coincides with Siemens spinning off Siemens Healthineers, Siemens Energy, and Siemens Gamesa into separately named entities. Those subsidiaries are not in this count.
- **Excluded Siemens entities are large.** Among the 188 other name matches, Siemens Healthcare, Siemens Mobility, Siemens Gamesa, Siemens Energy, Siemens Medical Solutions USA, Siemens Healthcare Diagnostics, and Siemens Industry are the biggest. If you want a group-wide picture, I can run those separately and merge them.
- **China is the one office that grew.** CN filings rose from around 430 in 2019 to over 570 in 2022, while DE direct filings fell by roughly 85 percent over the period as Siemens shifted toward EP and PCT routes.
- **Grant counts for recent years are low only because prosecution is still pending.** They are not a grant rate.
